# Eclipse extension contracts

The [UI plugin descriptor](../../org.review_board.ereviewboard.ui/plugin.xml) registers the Mylyn connector and editor page and declares `taskDiffActions` and `scmFileContentsLocator`. Their authoritative schemas are [taskDiffActions.exsd](../../org.review_board.ereviewboard.ui/schema/taskDiffActions.exsd) and [scmFileContentsLocator.exsd](../../org.review_board.ereviewboard.ui/schema/scmFileContentsLocator.exsd). `ReviewboardDiffPart` instantiates executable extensions from the registry and checks whether each applies to the current repository or diff revision.

To add an SCM integration: implement the [locator interface](../../org.review_board.ereviewboard.core/src/org/review_board/ereviewboard/core/internal/scm/SCMFileContentsLocator.java) in an SCM core bundle, register it through an SCM UI `plugin.xml`, declare bundle requirements/exports in manifests, and include both bundles in an optional feature. Use the existing [Subclipse UI](../org.review_board.ereviewboard.subclipse.ui/overview.md), [EGit UI](../org.review_board.ereviewboard.egit.ui/overview.md), or [CVS UI](../org.review_board.ereviewboard.cvs.ui/overview.md) as examples. For actions, extend [TaskDiffAction](../../org.review_board.ereviewboard.ui/src/org/review_board/ereviewboard/ui/editor/ext/TaskDiffAction.java) and register the action in `taskDiffActions`.

Keep the base connector independent of SCM-specific plug-ins. Test with the relevant feature installed in an Eclipse runtime; a missing SCM locator prevents loading base contents in the compare editor.
